extensions.bzor.systems/explicit-user-approval: KC requested raising contraction on all three, approximately 1.5x, to make the forms wider; literal multiplication was rejected as unstable and mapped to a 1.5x weaker inward gap.

hypothesis: Moving contraction one-third closer to neutral 1.0 will widen each regime while preserving its graph-turnover character.
mechanism: Preserve seed, attraction, repulsion, softening, and rewiring exactly; change only contraction to 0.9932, 0.9945, and 0.9932; rerun 100k VEX-authoritative 3D states and capture every step for 30fps review.
outputs: geometry receipts and original-versus-derived final metrics
question: Does a one-third reduction in inward contraction release all three selected 3D affinity regimes from the center without destroying their distinct motion?
stop_conditions: any VEX error or non-finite position
